note: Consumer subscription plans that include a model, entered by pull request. This is access information, never a score: it cannot move a composite, a rank or the coverage gate, and a plan fee is never converted into a per-token price. Every entry needs a source_url on the plan's own page and the date someone last read it; an entry without either is withheld. An empty list means nobody has recorded one, not that no plan exists.
max_age_days_rationale: An entry whose verified_at is older than this is set aside by the ingest without anyone having to notice: it leaves the published list and is named as expired, with the date it was last read and without its fee. Ninety days is one reading a quarter for whoever keeps this file. If the file is neglected the table gets shorter; it never shows an old price as a current one. Debatable by PR like every other number here.

fields.id: Unique and stable, lowercase, with the country when the same plan is entered for more than one.
fields.name: The plan's name as its own page prints it.
fields.price_per_month: The monthly fee as charged, a number. 0 for a free plan. null when the page lists no fee.
fields.currency: MXN or USD: the currency the fee is billed in. Leave it out when there is no fee.
fields.region: Two-letter country code in capitals of the country the price was read from, for example MX. The same plan costs different amounts in different countries.
fields.model_ids: Ids from data/models.json that the plan's own page says the plan includes. At least one.
fields.source_url: https URL of the page the fee and the models were read from.
fields.verified_at: The day someone last read that page, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not in the future.
